name: Example: An app HUD from the UI kit
description: Three shapes and a HUD built from the UI kit: a panel of kit buttons with tooltips and key hints, a split button with a menu, a window per shape with a colour drop-down and a progress bar of its turns, a Scene settings window whose property grid edits the picked shape (its spin, colour, position, rotation and wireframe) with a folder for the ground and the frame time, a Rename form that checks its fields, toasts, and a pause menu dialog opened with Escape, whose arrow keys are an action map in a context of its own and whose Reload shows the app's loading overlay.
